content:
Confirmed. Both registration sites are in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`, each calling into a distinct generated stub.

q19.

MemoService is served over two protocols, both registered in the same wiring file `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`:

- **Connect (Connect-RPC / connectrpc)** — `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go:40` (the `wrap(apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler(s, opts...))` call inside `RegisterConnectHandlers`), invoked from `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:141`. Mounted on `/memos.api.v1.*` (`v1.go:144`). The generated handler builder lives at `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/memo_service.connect.go:461`.

- **gRPC-Gateway (HTTP/JSON REST transcoding to the gRPC service)** — `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:108`, the `v1pb.RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer(ctx, gwMux, s)` call. Mounted on `/api/v1/*` (`v1.go:128`). The generated registration function lives at `proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.gw.go:961`.

Note: both wrap the same underlying `APIV1Service` gRPC implementation (`MemoServiceServer`, generated in `proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service_grpc.pb.go`); the `ConnectServiceHandler` doc comment at `connect_handler.go:17-20` states the intent explicitly — "Support both native gRPC and Connect protocols" from a single business-logic source.
